cases.name: Fetch MLflow tracking URI from AML workspace
cases.input: How do I get the MLflow tracking URI for my Azure ML workspace?
expected_behaviors: Shows ml_client.workspaces.get(workspace_name).mlflow_tracking_uri pattern
Does NOT suggest reading MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI from environment variable as primary method
Shows mlflow.set_tracking_uri(uri) call after resolving the URI
Mentions az ml workspace show --query mlflowTrackingUri as the CLI equivalent
should_not: Treat MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI env var as the primary/only resolution method

cases.name: Log metrics without double start_run on AML compute
cases.input: I want to log roc_auc and avg_average_precision after each CV fold in a training script running on AML compute.
expected_behaviors: Checks os.environ.get('AZUREML_RUN_ID') to detect AML compute environment
On AML compute: logs directly via mlflow.log_metric without calling mlflow.start_run()
On local compute: wraps with mlflow.active_run() check before starting a run
Uses consistent metric name format (e.g. roc_auc not roc-auc)
should_not: Unconditionally call mlflow.start_run() at the top of the script
Call mlflow.end_run() inside AML compute code

cases.name: Query top runs by metric
cases.input: Find the top 5 training runs from my experiment sorted by avg_average_precision.
expected_behaviors: Uses run_mlflow_query tool with the correct experiment_name and order_by_metric
Sets top_n=5
Summarises the metrics and params of the returned runs
Notes that the tracking URI must be resolved first if not already set
should_not: Write custom MLflow client code from scratch when run_mlflow_query tool is available
Query with an incorrect experiment name format (e.g. wrong separator)

cases.name: Register a trained model in MLflow model registry
cases.input: Register my LightGBM model from the best run as 'my-usecase_model_v1' in the model registry.
expected_behaviors: Uses mlflow.lightgbm.log_model (not mlflow.sklearn.log_model) to log the model artifact
Constructs model_uri as 'runs:/{run_id}/model' from the active run
Calls mlflow.register_model(model_uri, name='my-usecase_model_v1')
Follows the naming format {model_name}_v{version}
Outputs the registered model URI for downstream use
should_not: Use mlflow.sklearn.log_model for a LightGBM model
Register the model before logging it as an artifact
Hardcode a model version number without referencing the current version

cases.name: Compare past runs to decide on model promotion
cases.input: Compare the last 10 runs in my experiment and tell me which one has the best test_r2 for regression.
expected_behaviors: Queries runs ordered by test_r2 DESC with top_n=10
Displays run_id, test_r2, test_mae, and key params for each run
Identifies the best run by test_r2 and reports its run_id
Notes whether the best run's metrics meet typical acceptance thresholds (e.g. R² > 0.60)
should_not: Recommend promotion based solely on train_r2 without checking test_r2
Ignore test_mae or test_mape when evaluating regression model quality
Suggest promoting a model that shows signs of overfitting (large train/test gap)
